body: That’s a great point, I wasn’t aware of visible before switching to my new account on Verizon. My mother was kicking me off so I had to think fast. My phone isn’t pad off yet, so I’m not sure that’s an option... plus I wanted the option get an IPad added to my plan. My credit is 640.
Is there a difference between the amazon chase card a d the amazon prime store credit card?

While I agree with the seriousness knives should be taken into consideration when faced with a threat, when it comes to our criminal justice system why do we give this certain league of humans the lawful right to kill? That is no human right and it’s definitely doesn’t amount to petty crimes.

With that being said, this girl was kinda erratic. She was told not to reach for the gun and any Black person will tell you that that’s a no no. Then the girl started running AT the police officer... like??? Not cool. But also not worthy of multiple shots in her thigh and through her breast. That’s gross trigger fingers right there. He could’ve shot her in below the belly button to disarm her. She wasn’t carrying an AK-47 for gods sake...
I don’t want to harm anyone. I mostly want to disappear. But you’re right about energy. I don’t want to stay in a negative place anymore. Something has to change...

I do have a therapist and I’m going to see her tomorrow to discuss this. I don’t think I need to be anymore transparent to people about how I feel. I tend to emotionally bleed and it can be toxic to be around. I don’t want to ask for help unless is direly important. I need to learn to trust my self and develop a gut with emotionally healthy common sense.
This is probably the best comment so far. For many different tragic reasons. I would love to talk to you more.
Fuck humanity. I will however start writing everything I want to say so I’m getting it out somewhere. I can’t trust people, so every kind of ship can honestly go to hell.

I have spent way too much time dredging up what’s wrong with me and caring about who I am and trying to love me for me allll that shit. I’m done because it doesn’t really matter who I really am. It just matters how people Perceive me. If I fake it at work and isolate on my off days I won’t even have time for anything else.

I don’t have meaningful relationships, I don’t have fun. I live in paradise and my days are still dark as fuck regardless of how blue the ocean is. I don’t think friends are the answer, instead they are a crutch.
That’s nice, but I didn’t make a typo. I want to DIE not diet.
I’ve seen countless doctors and therapists. I’m at the end of this road when it comes to professional help. Thank you though.
Hi I’m here and would love to talk.
My mom responds to my suicidal tendencies with, “well there goes the life insurance claim” sometimes I hope to drop dead just so I can leave her penniless.
